msg: mapbox-gl v2+ dependency: since v2.0.0 (8 December 2020) mapbox-gl is licensed under the Mapbox TOS, not BSD-3-Clause. Use needs an active Mapbox account, and every Map object initialised is a billable map load. "latest", "*" and ">=1" all resolve to a 3.x release.
fix: npm uninstall mapbox-gl && npm install maplibre-gl (BSD-3-Clause), then fix the import lines this lint flags.

msg: mapbox-gl 1.x is still BSD-3-Clause, but 1.13.3 is the last BSD release: any upgrade past 1.x accepts the Mapbox TOS and map-load billing.
fix: Pin it exactly, or move to maplibre-gl: MapLibre GL JS was forked from mapbox-gl 1.13 and is maintained under BSD-3-Clause.

msg: Lockfile resolves mapbox-gl 2.x or 3.x: the Mapbox TOS licence ships in your bundle even if package.json looks harmless (a transitive or loose range).
fix: Find the parent with npm ls mapbox-gl, replace it with its MapLibre build, and reinstall so the lockfile no longer lists mapbox-gl.

msg: Mapbox GL JS v2/v3 loaded from a CDN: this is the Mapbox TOS build, and every page view that creates a map is a billable map load.
fix: Load https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.js and maplibre-gl.css instead (pin a version in production).

msg: Import of the mapbox-gl package: this is the line that pulls the Mapbox TOS code into your bundle.
fix: import maplibregl from 'maplibre-gl'; the Map, Marker, Popup and control classes keep the same names.

msg: Mapbox GL stylesheet: MapLibre ships its own stylesheet with maplibregl- class names, so the Mapbox CSS styles nothing after the switch.
fix: import 'maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.css' (or link maplibre-gl.css from the CDN).

msg: Mapbox access token: every Map initialised with it is a billable map load on your Mapbox account (50,000 a month free, then $5.00 per 1,000). MapLibre GL JS removed accessToken in its 2.0.0 release.
fix: Delete the token line. If your tiles still come from Mapbox, the Mapbox TOS and billing still apply: point the style at another tile host.

msg: Direct Mapbox API request: MapLibre will fetch it, but the request is billed and governed by the Mapbox TOS, so the migration is not finished.
fix: Replace it with your own tile/style host or an open service, and remove access_token from the URL.

msg: mapbox:// style URL: MapLibre GL JS 2.0.0 removed all mapbox:// URL handling, so this map loads blank after the switch.
fix: Use an https style.json URL, e.g. https://demotiles.maplibre.org/style.json for a test, or the style.json of your tile host.

msg: mapbox:// tileset, sprite or glyphs URL: MapLibre does not resolve mapbox:// URLs, so this layer, icon set or font stays empty.
fix: Use a TileJSON or {z}/{x}/{y} URL for sources and https URLs for sprite and glyphs.

msg: mapboxgl global: after the switch the global is maplibregl, so this line throws "mapboxgl is not defined".
fix: Rename mapboxgl. to maplibregl. (or import maplibregl and use it).

msg: mapboxgl- CSS class: MapLibre GL JS 3.0.0 removed the deprecated mapboxgl- class names, so this selector silently matches nothing.
fix: Rename the prefix to maplibregl- (mapboxgl-ctrl becomes maplibregl-ctrl, mapboxgl-popup becomes maplibregl-popup).

msg: react-map-gl Mapbox entry point: the bare 'react-map-gl' import (v7) and 'react-map-gl/mapbox' (v8) wrap mapbox-gl.
fix: import Map from 'react-map-gl/maplibre' (react-map-gl 8) or from '@vis.gl/react-maplibre', and drop mapboxAccessToken.

msg: Mapbox geocoder plugin: it sends every search to the Mapbox Geocoding API with your token, so geocoding stays on Mapbox billing after the map moves.
fix: Use @maplibre/maplibre-gl-geocoder (ISC) and pass it a forwardGeocode function for the geocoding service you choose.

msg: @mapbox/mapbox-gl-draw is ISC-licensed and runs on MapLibre, but its toolbar uses mapboxgl-ctrl class names, so the buttons render unstyled.
fix: Before new MapboxDraw(), set MapboxDraw.constants.classes.CONTROL_BASE = 'maplibregl-ctrl', CONTROL_PREFIX = 'maplibregl-ctrl-' and CONTROL_GROUP = 'maplibregl-ctrl-group'.

msg: map.setFog() is Mapbox-only: MapLibre has no setFog, so this call throws.
fix: Use map.setSky({...}): MapLibre puts sky, horizon and fog colours in one sky specification (fog-color, horizon-fog-blend).

msg: Mapbox Standard style configuration (setConfigProperty, v3): there is no MapLibre equivalent, the call throws and the Standard style cannot be loaded.
fix: Pick a style.json you host, then change its look with setPaintProperty / setLayoutProperty on named layers.
